note: Hosted Notion MCP (mcp.notion.com). Names, descriptions and argument names from Notion's public tool documentation; schemas trimmed to the arguments that page documents.

tools.name: notion-search
tools.description: Searches Notion pages and databases, or looks up a workspace user by name or email. Supports location (page, data source, or teamspace), creator or editor, date and title filters.

query.description: Short, specific keywords or a page title

tools.name: notion-fetch
tools.description: Retrieves content from a Notion page, database, data source, or saved database view by its URL or ID. Fetching a database returns its data sources (collection://...) with their schema and templates.

id.description: Page, database or data source URL or ID

tools.name: notion-create-pages
tools.description: Creates one or more Notion pages with specified properties and content. A page under a data source parent is a new database row. Supports applying database templates.

content.description: Notion-flavoured Markdown; '- [ ] item' is a to-do block

tools.name: notion-update-page
tools.description: Update a Notion page's properties, content, icon, or cover, or apply a database template to an existing page. Commands: update_properties (set property values such as Status or a checkbox), update_content (search-and-replace edits), replace_content, apply_template.

page_id.description: The page (or database row) to update

properties.description: For update_properties: property name to new value, e.g. {"Status": "Done", "Done": "__YES__"}

new_str.description: For replace_content: the page's new Markdown

tools.name: notion-move-pages
tools.description: Move one or more Notion pages or databases to a new parent.

tools.name: notion-duplicate-page
tools.description: Duplicate a Notion page within your workspace. Completes asynchronously.

tools.name: notion-delete-pages
tools.description: Move up to 20 Notion pages to Trash. Database rows are pages. The call must set user_confirmed: true. Items in Trash can be restored with notion-restore-pages.

tools.name: notion-restore-pages
tools.description: Restore up to 20 Notion pages or databases from Trash to where they were before they were deleted.

tools.name: notion-create-database
tools.description: Creates a new Notion database, initial data source, and initial view with the specified properties.

tools.name: notion-update-data-source
tools.description: Update a Notion data source's properties (columns), name, description, or page layout. Omitted select or status options are removed.

tools.name: notion-query-data-sources
tools.description: Query Notion data sources with SQL, read rows from one data source (mode rows), or run a saved view (mode view).

data_source_url.description: collection://... of the data source to read

tools.name: notion-create-comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a page or specific content. Supports page-level comments, block-level comments, and replies to existing discussions.

tools.name: notion-get-comments
tools.description: Lists all comments and discussions on a page, including block-level and resolved threads.
